segs.topic: Enemy Charlie's protest-violence panel
segs.summary: He watches Enemy Charlie's stream and a panel video on the left–liberal split, going back over a debate on whether protest vandalism should always be condemned, where Wick pressed Charlie and Hutch raised the LA protests.

segs.topic: Nonviolence research and a Steve Harvey story
segs.summary: He cites research finding nonviolent movements succeed more often than violent ones, then watches a viral debate moment and a clip of Steve Harvey telling money stories.

segs.topic: Catching up on Tati's 'Bye Sister' video
segs.summary: Having never followed beauty YouTube, he starts working through the 2019 James Charles saga, beginning with Tati Westbrook's video accusing her former protégé.

segs.topic: James Charles's 'No More Lies' response
segs.summary: He watches James Charles's receipts-heavy rebuttal to Tati and comments on how the creator-apology genre works and how the public verdict flipped.

segs.topic: Harley Morenstein's 'Future of H3' stream
segs.summary: He turns to the H3 Podcast blow-up, watching Harley Morenstein's stream about the show's future and reading the leaked texts around the Kleins' separation.

segs.topic: Snark subreddits and a video about him
segs.summary: Between bits of Harley's stream he scrolls snark posts, including an AI 'map' of the Hutch–SoyPill debate and a critic's video about him, arguing these communities follow the money.

segs.topic: Harley's stream: who knew what, and the crew
segs.summary: More reading on the H3 situation: what the texts imply about who knew of the affair, the crew's position and the business side of the show.

segs.topic: Tati's later video naming Jeffree Star and Shane Dawson
segs.summary: He watches Tati's follow-up claiming she was pushed into the original video by Jeffree Star and Shane Dawson, and her apology to James.

segs.topic: Dramageddon recap documentary
segs.summary: He switches to a long recap video laying out how the beauty-community feud escalated, the sponsorship dispute at its root and how each figure came out of it.

segs.topic: Call: Ukraine, Marxism-Leninism and a fundraiser
segs.summary: A caller plugs a fundraiser for a Ukrainian streamer friend, then they discuss self-described authoritarian leftists, Putin's justifications for the invasion and why Marxism-Leninism appeals to some people.

segs.topic: Scrolling snark posts about himself
segs.summary: He reads through posts and tweets from accounts that track him, mocking the framing of several and deciding a few aren't worth engaging with.

segs.topic: Dramageddon recap: Jeffree Star as puppet master
segs.summary: The recap's closing chapters on Jeffree Star's role, the later allegations against James and why the recapper says there were no winners.

segs.topic: Long COVID and functional illness
segs.summary: He watches a writer discuss her reporting on long COVID and functional neurological disorder and weighs in on how to talk about real symptoms with psychological components.

segs.topic: Donation reading and sign-off
segs.summary: A loose wind-down reading donations and chat messages before ending the stream.

days.title: In my Estimation it is Time to Deploy the Stream

segs.topic: Three-person podcast on snark, ad money and Pisco
segs.summary: He watches a three-person online show discuss political ad reads and super PAC money, snark-scene tactics around his court case, Hutch and SoyPill, and the Pisco and Mantis orbit.

segs.topic: Podcast panel on the leaked H3 texts
segs.summary: The same panel picks apart the leaked texts between Harley and the Kleins and argues over who leaked what and whether the show survives.

segs.topic: Lawyer video on how criminal trials work
segs.summary: He watches a defense lawyer's video on jury rules, how the prosecution's story is built and ineffective-assistance appeals.

segs.topic: Trivia games break
segs.summary: He plays a few quick trivia and grid games with chat.

segs.topic: 60 Minutes on the first US deaths of the Iran war
segs.summary: He watches a TV investigation into the drone attack at a base in Kuwait that killed the war's first American troops, with families questioning warnings that went unheeded.

segs.topic: Jubilee: Kevin O'Leary vs. Gen Z on work and wages
segs.summary: He watches Kevin O'Leary debate young challengers on work-life balance, minimum wage and whether college is worth it, mostly siding against the weaker arguments on both sides.

segs.topic: O'Leary debate: equity, pay and passion
segs.summary: The debate moves to entrepreneurship, giving workers equity, executive pay and whether execution matters more than passion.

segs.topic: O'Leary debate: unions, company values and AI
segs.summary: Final rounds on unions, whether to pick a job for its values, and AI and billionaires, with Destiny critiquing O'Leary's answers.

segs.topic: Viewer emails and quick takes
segs.summary: He reads a batch of emails, including one from a freight-regulation worker and one about fear of rising antisemitism.

segs.topic: Nvidia chip-smuggling story
segs.summary: He doubts claims the Chinese state engineered a scandal around Jensen Huang and argues Nvidia just wants to sell openly to China.

segs.topic: Jeffries' caucus vote and the left's purity tests
segs.summary: He reacts to Emma Vigeland and Sam Seder brushing off Van Hollen's endorsement of Hakeem Jeffries, and argues the left purity-tests its own side over the leadership vote.

segs.topic: Surgery videos and health-cost clips
segs.summary: A break watching orthopedic surgery clips and a couple of health-policy posts.

segs.topic: Advice columns and relationship posts
segs.summary: He reads and mocks a run of advice-column letters and relationship posts.

segs.topic: Nick Fuentes reacts to the Destiny–Hasan dynamic
segs.summary: He watches a clip of Nick Fuentes discovering the Destiny–Hasan rivalry for the first time and pushes back on parts of it.

segs.topic: Chat break
segs.summary: Short chat-reading break.

segs.topic: Game-warden lobster bust videos
segs.summary: He ends watching wildlife-officer bodycam videos of undersized lobster and crab catches, joking about the charges.

segs.topic: Hila Klein's statement on the H3 breakup
segs.summary: He watches Hila Klein's account of the separation, the affair timeline and Harley's role, commenting on what it means for the show and crew.

segs.topic: Watching Enemy Charlie's stream: TwitchCon and leaving debate
segs.summary: He watches Enemy Charlie's stream as she talks about TwitchCon, stepping back from the debate scene and the harassment she says she gets, reacting to her claims about him and his community.

segs.topic: Enemy Charlie's stream: gender, Hasan's chat and the snark war
segs.summary: More of her stream, including her playing a Hasan reaction video about Destiny, arguments over gender and transition, and complaints about specific critics, with Destiny rebutting parts of it.

segs.topic: Raid and late-night politics chat
segs.summary: He looks for a channel to raid and chats briefly about Democratic Party news before signing off.

segs.topic: Nvidia's board and Jensen Huang
segs.summary: He opens on the story of Nvidia's board and Jensen Huang, comparing it to benching Michael Jordan.

segs.topic: Elon Musk at DealBook: midterm money and Starlink
segs.summary: He watches Elon Musk's DealBook interview on his losing midterm spending, threats of investigations, and Starlink's role in Ukraine.

segs.topic: Musk at DealBook: Star Shield, SpaceX and AI compute
segs.summary: The interview moves to military Star Shield, Starlink's lead, and SpaceX selling compute to AI labs, with Destiny skeptical of Musk's answers.

segs.topic: Ro Khanna on TYT: why he backs Jeffries
segs.summary: He watches Ro Khanna explain on TYT why he is backing Hakeem Jeffries for speaker and push the war-powers fight, and is scornful of the reasoning.

segs.topic: Commentary show on the Jeffries vote
segs.summary: He watches a commentary show and CNN panel clips on the caucus vote and the left's criticism of Jeffries, disputing the framing.

segs.topic: Bulwark: Van Hollen's pitch to lead Senate Democrats
segs.summary: He watches Chris Van Hollen on The Bulwark make his case for a new approach to Senate leadership.

segs.topic: Blue Wave prep: Zoom labels and theme song
segs.summary: He and Mr. Mouton fiddle with Zoom name labels, fonts and the missing intro song before the show.

segs.topic: The Blue Wave ep. 2: Jeffries wins the caucus vote
segs.summary: On The Blue Wave with IRI and Mr. Mouton he celebrates Jeffries' lopsided caucus win, mocks the holdouts and debates AIPAC as a litmus test.

segs.topic: The Blue Wave: minimum wage, tax credits and infrastructure
segs.summary: The panel argues over what a minimum-wage worker should be able to afford, tax credits, and Republicans' record in power.

segs.topic: The Blue Wave: Schumer, Van Hollen and the generation fight
segs.summary: They discuss the Senate leadership race, the generational argument and DSA complaints about the party.

segs.topic: The Blue Wave: Paxton, Xi and Putin, and Patreon questions
segs.summary: Final segment on Ken Paxton replacing Cornyn, Xi and Putin, streamers' political pull, and listener questions.

segs.topic: Post-show chat and H3 memes
segs.summary: He winds down after the show with chat, H3 memes and a few short clips.

segs.topic: Ben Shapiro on NPR: Trump, Iran and the right
segs.summary: He watches NPR's interview with Ben Shapiro on how his view of Trump has changed and the Iran war.

segs.topic: Shapiro on NPR: Rubio vs. Vance and the guardrails
segs.summary: The rest of the Shapiro interview covers 2028 Republican hopefuls, gerrymandering and whether democracy is in danger.

segs.topic: Why Schumer's critics are wrong
segs.summary: He reacts to a podcast clip on the Schumer–Van Hollen fight, arguing Schumer saved his whip power for votes that mattered.

segs.topic: Chat banter and health questions
segs.summary: A loose start fielding chat questions on health topics and stream logistics.

segs.topic: Hasan on Neera Tanden and Black voters
segs.summary: He watches Hasan Piker go after Neera Tanden and the Center for American Progress and comment on older Black voters, and disagrees with the framing.

segs.topic: Harley Morenstein's side of the H3 split
segs.summary: He watches Harley's stream explaining his involvement, what he told Hila and when, and his reasons for leaving H3.

segs.topic: Harley's stream: contracts, texts and the crew
segs.summary: More of Harley's account of his contract, the leaked picture and texts, and the crew's position, with Destiny judging how each side has handled it.

segs.topic: Caller: is there really a Democratic Party?
segs.summary: A caller argues the US Democratic Party has no real central structure; they compare it with European parliamentary parties and discuss how Clinton and Obama shaped it.

segs.topic: Rebuttal video on Andrew Wilson and women's suffrage
segs.summary: After a few short clips he watches a video taking apart a conservative podcaster's argument for repealing women's right to vote.

segs.topic: Reddit and chat
segs.summary: Brief subreddit and chat browsing.

segs.topic: Minecraft: Ender Dragon fight
segs.summary: He plays Minecraft with friends and takes on the Ender Dragon.

segs.topic: Trump speech clips
segs.summary: He reacts to clips of Trump touting deportations, crime numbers and strikes on boats before wrapping up.

segs.topic: News scroll: the FBI database hack
segs.summary: He starts with a few headlines, including a reported hack of an FBI crime database.

segs.topic: Mr. Beat on what 'centrism' means
segs.summary: He watches Mr. Beat's explainer on centrism and political spectrums.

segs.topic: Former H3 crew member's stream
segs.summary: He watches a stream by a former H3 cast member about his time on the show, Ethan and other cast members, reacting to his version of events.

segs.topic: Ex-H3 cast stream: HR complaints and Ethan
segs.summary: More of the same stream: workplace complaints, how Ethan handled them and whether he returns.

segs.topic: AB, Lonerbox and Dan Saltman in the H3 orbit
segs.summary: He looks at claims about AB's apology to Lonerbox and Dan Saltman's role as an H3 sponsor.

segs.topic: Enemy Charlie clips and Hasan's chat
segs.summary: He reads Enemy Charlie's posts about her family background and Hasan's chat reaction, disputing claims about him.

segs.topic: Minecraft check-in
segs.summary: A quick Minecraft break.

segs.topic: Post-midterm videos: Trump and the blame game
segs.summary: He watches post-midterm clips and commentary videos on Trump's statements, young voters and the right blaming its losses on others.

segs.topic: Sam Harris and CBS on Epstein's death
segs.summary: He watches Sam Harris argue Epstein almost certainly killed himself and a CBS News investigation questioning the autopsy, weighing the forensic claims.

segs.topic: 'Burrito-gate' and chat
segs.summary: A brief detour into a viral fight over burrito prices.

segs.topic: Epstein callers: what would change your mind?
segs.summary: He takes callers who think Epstein was killed, pressing each for evidence and arguing the record points to suicide.

segs.topic: Call: will Ethan Klein come back?
segs.summary: A caller asks about the H3 fallout; he predicts Ethan will struggle to return to a smaller, different audience.

segs.topic: A comedy podcast's farewell episode
segs.summary: He watches the last episode of a two-host comedy podcast and its super chats.

segs.topic: Wrap-up
segs.summary: Chat and closing.

segs.topic: A creator's accountability video
segs.summary: He browses YouTube and watches a creator's video addressing a past allegation and his response to it.

segs.topic: Zeteo panel: progressives after the midterms
segs.summary: He watches a Zeteo panel on what the midterms mean for the left, El-Sayed's race, primary money and Jeffries, arguing with several claims.

segs.topic: Chat break
segs.summary: Short chat break.

segs.topic: David Frum on the filibuster
segs.summary: He watches The David Frum Show's history of the Senate filibuster and what changing it would mean.

segs.topic: Streamer drama and merch posts
segs.summary: He reads about another streamer's situation and comment-section reactions.

segs.topic: 'What does Hasan Piker do next?' interview
segs.summary: He watches a sit-down interview asking what Hasan Piker does after the Democrats' win, covering his audience, Talarico and Platner, commenting throughout.

segs.topic: Hasan interview: Israel, rhetoric and his lawsuit
segs.summary: The interview turns to antisemitism, his rhetoric, his defamation suit and a possible AOC run, with Destiny disputing several answers.

segs.topic: Call: his harassment lawsuit and doxxing ethics
segs.summary: A caller talks Star Wars, then about his lawsuit's evidence, what counts as doxxing and how harassment campaigns spread.

segs.topic: Call: Israel, Hasan and El-Sayed
segs.summary: The call shifts to Israel–Palestine, how Hasan talks about it, and El-Sayed and Ilhan Omar.

segs.topic: Luke Beasley's interview with Nick Fuentes
segs.summary: He watches Luke Beasley grill Nick Fuentes on race, his 2016 activity, Ukraine and Epstein, calling it one of the most contentious interviews he has seen.

segs.topic: Chat break
segs.summary: Short chat break.

segs.topic: Tucker Carlson joins The Young Turks
segs.summary: He watches Cenk Uygur interview Tucker Carlson about Israel, the Iran war, his time at Fox and the right's direction.

segs.topic: Tucker on TYT: the media and the 'regime'
segs.summary: More of the Carlson–Uygur interview on media, Israel and the establishment, with a short Minecraft break.

segs.topic: Enemy Charlie, Progressive Victory and doxxing claims
segs.summary: He goes through Enemy Charlie's posts and stream, plus claims about Progressive Victory and accusations around Hasan and doxxing.

segs.topic: Late news clips and sign-off
segs.summary: A few news clips and chat before ending.
